questions.answer: Different. At UCPH it is easy to discover the syllasbus. Here it is very difficult as it is almost impossible to figure out what the "essential reading" is.

questions.answer: Haematology, Protein sorting, Proteins, Introduction to virology, Cell membrane structure and function and Membrane excitablility.
